description: This file is a shell script containing test definitions for verifying the compatibility of reftables with JGit in a Git-related project. It includes setup, prerequisite checks, and test cases for reading repositories with JGit and CGit, as well as handling references, reflogs, and multi-level indexes.

methods.name: test_commit_jgit
methods.description: Creates a commit in a JGit repository with the specified file.

methods.name: test_same_refs
methods.description: Compares the reference listings between git and jgit outputs to verify they are consistent.

methods.name: test_same_ref
methods.description: Verifies that specific references have the same commit hash in git and jgit.

methods.name: test_same_reflog
methods.description: Checks that reflogs created by git and jgit match for specific references.
